tagline: The floor · The fit · The afters

stars.text: Start the thing you have been putting off, this week. Send the application, the text, or the ask. Then stop, before you turn it into a fight.
Look at what you spent last month. Buy one thing you will still use next year, and skip the extra orders.
Answer the message you have been sitting on, or delete it. Leaving it unread is the part wearing you out.
Text the person you actually want to see, and make a plan at home. Cook, or just sit. A night in counts.
Ask out loud for what you want: the job, the date, or the credit. People cannot give you what you never said.
Finish one chore all the way: the bills, the laundry, or the inbox. Then stop. You do not need a whole new system.
Stop asking the group and pick the plan. Send the day, the time, and the place. More opinions will not help.
Tell one person the hard thing, in private. Keep it off your story and out of the group chat.
Book the trip, the class, or the weekend you keep talking about. Say yes to one real plan, not five maybes.
Pick a time you stop working, and stop. Write down the money you owe, and the money you are owed.
Make your own plan and invite one person. You do not need the whole group chat to agree first.
Go to bed on time twice this week. Drink water before anything else. You can leave early. That still counts as a good night.
